blogs.title: How QLoRA Lets You Fine-tune 65B LLMs on a Single 48GB GPU
blogs.description: A practical, non-technical walkthrough of the QLoRA approach: what changes compared to traditional finetuning, why 4-bit storage + 16-bit compute works, required hardware, expected runtimes, and a step-by-step plan to finetune large models (33B/65B) on a single consumer/professional GPU.

blogs.title: NF4 and Double Quantization — Demystifying 4-bit Quantization for LLMs
blogs.description: An accessible deep dive into the two key quantization innovations from QLoRA: the intuition behind NormalFloat (NF4) and why Double Quantization saves memory without hurting performance, illustrated with simple visual examples and pitfalls to watch for.

blogs.title: LoRA Everywhere: Why Putting Adapters on Every Layer Recovers Full-Precision Performance
blogs.description: Explains the LoRA adapter design choices used in QLoRA, why applying adapters to more (or all) linear layers matters, recommended hyperparameters, and practical tips for tuning LoRA rank, scaling, and training schedules to match 16-bit finetuning.

blogs.title: From LLaMA to Guanaco: How a Few Thousand High-Quality Examples Built a Chatbot Rivaling ChatGPT
blogs.description: A narrative-style case study of the Guanaco models: dataset selection (OASST1 vs FLAN/Alpaca), training recipe, evaluation outcomes, and concrete lessons on why data quality sometimes trumps dataset size for instruction-following chatbots.

blogs.title: Evaluating Chatbots at Scale: Using GPT-4 vs Human Raters — An Honest Comparison
blogs.description: Breaks down the tournament-style evaluation and Elo rating approach used in QLoRA, how GPT-4 automated judgments compare to human annotators, known biases (order effects, self-preference), and best practices for reliable chatbot evaluation.

blogs.title: Reproducing QLoRA: A Pragmatic Guide with Hugging Face, bitsandbytes and the QLoRA Repo
blogs.description: A hands-on how-to for practitioners: required libraries, installing the CUDA kernels, preparing quantized checkpoints, running paged optimizers, sample finetuning scripts, and common debugging tips when following the QLoRA codebases on GitHub.

blogs.title: Finetuning on the Edge: How QLoRA Opens the Door to Personalization on Phones and Low‑Resource Devices
blogs.description: Explores the implications of tiny memory footprints (e.g., 7B on ~5GB), what on-device finetuning could enable (privacy, personalization), realistic throughput/rate estimates for phones, and limitations and security considerations for mobile deployments.

blogs.title: Responsible and Safe Finetuning with QLoRA: Risks, Biases and Practical Mitigations
blogs.description: A focused post on the ethical and safety aspects of making large-model finetuning widely accessible: dataset curation, leakage checks, bias testing, guardrails, and governance advice for small teams or hobbyists using QLoRA responsibly.

blogs.title: Why Data Quality Beats Quantity for Instruction Tuning: Evidence from 1,000+ QLoRA Experiments
blogs.description: Summarizes the paper's large-scale findings showing that smaller, high-quality instruction datasets can outperform much larger corpora on chatbot benchmarks; includes recommended dataset selection criteria and simple filtering/curation strategies to get more signal from less data.
